text:
open_spec_requests in crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs only counts open jobs whose request holds the exact 'Spec requirement: <id>' line. Retries that an introspection proposes for a spec-gap job do not carry that line, so the planner queues the bare template again beside them, or right after them. Make a retry of a spec-gap job keep the 'Spec requirement: <id>' line, so the open-request check sees it. When the requirement's most recent spec job was rejected or failed, build the re-queued request from that job's recorded findings and the introspection's proposed request, not from the bare template. Add tests: (a) an open retry without the template text still counts as the open request for that requirement; (b) a re-queue after a rejection includes the earlier verifier finding. Update the doc comments and add a CHANGELOG.md entry. cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings and cargo test pass.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: After a spec-gap job is rejected, the next drain queues the same bare template again. It ignores the introspection's sharper retry, so the same requirement gets two competing jobs.
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass
